checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One continuous excerpt of the source with framing and speed preserved
must.why: AI re-render at 832x512 with new invented scenes (pilot cockpit shots) that don't match the source's cockpit-screen frame; framing changed.

must.item: Excerpt contains salient jet action or cockpit interaction
must.why: Jets in formation and pilots in cockpits are shown, though possibly invented.

must.item: Original sound remains synchronized; no replacement music, narration, captions added
must.why: Captions were added/burned in ('Got. Hewice with me?', 'Right here, Vega.'), garbled; audio can't be verified as original.

faults.what: Output is an AI re-render, not an exact trim; scenes look generated and differ from the source framing.
Burned-in garbled subtitles ('Got. Hewice with me?', 'Right here, Vega.') appear, though no text was wanted.
Low resolution 832x512 and AI artefacts (smeared jet at 1s, warped helmet/mask details).
Original audio is not verifiably preserved.

summary: The result is a 10-second AI re-render with generated cockpit and jet scenes and garbled added subtitles, not a faithful trim of the original, so it breaks the user's no-text, original-framing requirements.
